correctness.rationale: For any strictly positive parameters, conditional Dirichlet moments give E[G|X_i=x]=x²+c_i(1−x)². Two exact beta integration identities yield the stated affine threshold factor. Its positive prefactors, together with tau_i<1 from c_i<=1, prove the sign classification. Symmetric summation and normalized independent gamma asymptotics give the exact Greenwood case and a valid joint CLT. Actual checker confirmed 114 exact integer beta-integral cases, 30 noninteger high-precision cases and six independent gamma covariance integral cases. Finite checking was not used to justify universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: Greenwood quadratic dispersion and gap/exceedance counts are distinct natural diagnostics. Their null covariance has a sharp and interpretable finite crossover, at twice the mean spacing asymptotically, not a uniform sign. Arbitrary Dirichlet anisotropy can eliminate the crossover, fully classified by tau_i. The explicit nondegenerate bivariate Gaussian covariance shows persistence of the threshold in the sampling limit and a point of limiting independence. No unsupported testing-power benefit is asserted.
